name: AAC - 21 - Sync Doctor Profiles from Workbook

parameters.sqlQuery:
-- TEST-1 pilot only. The workbook is the maintainable editing surface; BigQuery remains the runtime system of record.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctor_profiles` (
  doctor_id STRING NOT NULL, practice_id STRING NOT NULL, work_email STRING,
  doctor_name STRING, credentials STRING, location_code STRING, profile_url STRING,
  photo_url STRING, short_bio STRING, source STRING, verified_at TIMESTAMP, active BOOL
);
ALTER TABLE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctor_profiles`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS credentials STRING;

MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctor_profiles` T
USING (
  SELECT d.doctor_id, d.practice_id, @work_email AS work_email, @doctor_name AS doctor_name,
    NULLIF(@credentials, '') AS credentials, @location_code AS location_code,
    @profile_url AS profile_url, @photo_url AS photo_url, @short_bio AS short_bio,
    @source AS source, TIMESTAMP(@verified_at) AS verified_at, CAST(@active AS BOOL) AS active
  FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d
  JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.practices` p USING (practice_id)
  WHERE LOWER(d.email) = LOWER(@work_email)
    AND d.practice_id = 'practice_test_001'
    AND @location_code = 'TEST-1'
  LIMIT 1
) S
ON T.doctor_id = S.doctor_id AND T.practice_id = S.practice_id
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET
  work_email = S.work_email, doctor_name = S.doctor_name, credentials = S.credentials,
  location_code = S.location_code, profile_url = S.profile_url, photo_url = S.photo_url,
  short_bio = S.short_bio, source = S.source, verified_at = S.verified_at, active = S.active
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
  (doctor_id, practice_id, work_email, doctor_name, credentials, location_code, profile_url, photo_url, short_bio, source, verified_at, active)
VALUES
  (S.doctor_id, S.practice_id, S.work_email, S.doctor_name, S.credentials, S.location_code, S.profile_url, S.photo_url, S.short_bio, S.source, S.verified_at, S.active);

INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
  (event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp, source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload)
SELECT GENERATE_UUID(), 'doctor', d.doctor_id, 'doctor.profile_synced', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  'n8n:doctor-profile-sync', NULL, TO_JSON(STRUCT(@location_code AS location_code, @profile_url AS profile_url, @photo_url AS photo_url))
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d
WHERE LOWER(d.email) = LOWER(@work_email) AND d.practice_id = 'practice_test_001';

SELECT d.doctor_id, d.practice_id, @work_email AS work_email, @doctor_name AS doctor_name,
  @location_code AS location_code, 'SYNCED' AS sync_status
FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d
WHERE LOWER(d.email) = LOWER(@work_email) AND d.practice_id = 'practice_test_001'
LIMIT 1;

parameters.content:
## Doctor profile workbook sync

Manual, inactive pilot workflow. It reads the **Doctor Profiles** tab and synchronizes exactly one active **TEST-1** row for **jdold@apexdp.com** into BigQuery. It does not email anyone or publish anything.

Connect the existing **Google Sheets account** and **Google BigQuery account** credentials before the first run. Production expansion should reuse the same workbook columns but replace the TEST-1 guard with the canonical location-to-practice mapping.
